messages:
kevin: Quick sync - need final call on burst offering for Dedicated GA. Option A: burst packs (add-on SKUs). Option B: elastic tier (auto-scale commit). Thoughts? @maria @tomo
maria: vote for burst packs. simpler billing and legal. customers like predictability.
tomo: packs are faster to ship. key asks: 1) rollover window, 2) visibility in console, 3) alerts. propose 30d rollover.
elaine: legal flags on auto-bill. if we do elastic, must require explicit amend for >$3k/mo auto-charge. for packs, recommend non-refundable but transferable with admin request.
billing-bot: CONTRACT-BURST-02 exists 14-day invoice term and soft overage clause (internal/contracts/CONTRACT-BURST-02)
kevin: infra note: elastic needs new preemption logic. packs only need quota checks + fallback variant. estimate: packs = 2 sprints, elastic = 4+.
maria: acceptance checklist for GA: AE price sheet + SKU, console purchase flow, quota dashboard, billing events, fallback routing, telemetry by model + route, regression tests.
tomo: action items: maria -> pricing sheet, elaine -> clause draft (EOD Thu), kevin -> infra PRD + estimate, I'll stub telemetry schema and alerts. Reconvene after PRDs.
kevin: leaning packs by consensus. marking as dependency for Dedicated GA.
